steps.content: This is the core of the contamination, the Ring's owner.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Doesn't look like her at all.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This monster has swallowed two Sinners. Earl is inside too.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's probably more powerful than any other enemies we've encountered before. Be very careful.
You sense a familiar evil aura and hear its nauseating heartbeat —it's very similar to the inheritance, but it's not yet entirely active.
Perhaps the fresh wounds covering its body are buying you time, but the person who made those wounds is not here.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It needs time to heal the wounds on its body. That driver's friend is likely also a powerful Sinner and possesses power we don't know of...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If we'd arrived sooner and fought together...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop with the what-ifs. That person is most certainly dead, and if we don't act now, once the monster wakes, we'll be next!
She throws out her pipe to hit the Corpseborne —but it rebounds off something like a ward.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's a ward! Could it be that under the Black Ring's veil, all attacks against the Corpseborne will be rejected?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those monsters again! Tell me I didn't wake them?
Around the Corpseborne, one after another... no, a huge crowd of furious Corruptors is emerging. Their aggressiveness obviously seems way more intense than in any other battles before.
